current_text.html:
Permanent Committees and Agencies may appoint subcommittees for specific tasks or areas of responsibility assigned by the General Assembly, according to the following guidelines:

a. Membership of subcommittees may include persons not elected to the permanent Committee or Agency, provided the subcommittee chairman is a permanent Committee or Agency member.
b. All policies and procedures of a subcommittee must be approved by the permanent Committee or Agency prior to implementation.
c. The staff of a subcommittee is controlled by the permanent Committee or Agency through its chief administrative officer.

relationships.title: SJC member eligibility for concurrent GA agency board service

occurrences.excerpt: The CCB advised that a member of the GA's Standing Judicial Commission is eligible to serve concurrently on the board of a General Assembly agency.
